scores.tell: Duck body has glossy plastic hot spots and strong saturated form turn, slightly too shiny/inflated; spring has sharp chrome highlights.
Bottle has many sharp white water-drop speculars and a glossy sheen on the blue body; real cards are softer.
none; soft broad highlights, gentle form turn, soft contact shadow like the real towel/calculator style.
Barrel has painted wood-grain texture, a hard-edged cast shadow and banded metal hoops; looks like the graded-down barrel.
Ship is fairly flat and illustrative, with crisp white wave foam highlights. Sails have little form turn and the hull shading is graphic.
none; smooth rounded forms, soft sheen and gentle shadow, close to the real towel.
Painterly, textured landscape and cart with heavy cast shadows under the wheels. This is the too-texture-y, illustrated feel of the lower-graded cart.
Slightly flat soft shading on the clock and a thin dark ground shadow. Otherwise close to the real style.
Locker has a broad glossy sheen and strong orange saturation. Interior shadows are heavy and the basketball and shoes are rendered quite realistically.
Rocket has chrome-like sharp metallic highlights on the silver body and glossy red fins, which gives a plastic hot-spot look.
